name: Fourier N1
summary: Fourier's open-source humanoid: the company published the full bill of materials, CAD, assembly guide and control software. The compact 1.3 m / 38 kg body uses Fourier's FSA 2.0 actuators, runs at up to 3.5 m/s and logged over 1,000 hours of outdoor testing before release.
notable: 1,000+ hours of outdoor trials before launch

sources.title: China Unveils First Open-Source Humanoid Robot Fourier N1 — TMTPost
